title: Logarithmic moments of the Rogers-Ramanujan continued fraction and odd zeta values
summary: We study how the two cusp expansions of the Rogers-Ramanujan continued fraction control its ordinary and logarithmic Mellin moments. Ramanujan's factorizations express the logarithmic transform as a combination of products of zeta and quadratic Dirichlet $L$-functions. Its adjacent integer and half-integer values give an invertible change of coordinates for the corresponding odd special values. We prove that every reciprocal-cusp coefficient is a quadratic irrational algebraic integer, with an explicit minimal polynomial, and that every logarithmic coefficient is quadratic irrational.
